ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
What is the maximum number of $T$-shaped polyominos (shown below) that we can put into a $6 \times 6$ grid without any overlaps. The blocks can be rotated.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The tile shown in the image is a T-shaped tetromino: it is made of 4 unit squares, with 3 connected in a row and the other 1 attached to one side of the middle square; the problem asks to place it into a 6×6 grid, with rotation allowed. First look at the area upper bound: a 6×6 has a total of 36 cells, and each T occupies 4 cells, so at most no more than floor(36/4)=9 can fit. Then use black-white checkerboard coloring: the 6×6 board has 18 black cells and 18 white cells. Any T tetromino, no matter how it is rotated, will cover 3 cells of one color and 1 cell of the other color, so each T contributes ±2 to the black-white difference. If 9 are placed and completely fill the 36 cells, the total black-white difference must be 0, but after dividing the sum of 9 ±2's by 2, it is the sum of 9 ±1's, and an odd number of ±1's cannot sum to 0, so 9 is impossible. Thus the upper bound drops to 8. Finally give a concrete placement of 8: numbering rows and columns from 1 to 6, they can be placed at {(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2)}, {(2,1),(3,1),(4,1),(3,2)}, {(4,2),(4,3),(4,4),(3,3)}, {(1,4),(2,4),(3,4),(2,3)}, {(1,5),(2,5),(3,5),(2,6)}, {(3,6),(4,6),(5,6),(4,5)}, {(6,1),(6,2),(6,3),(5,2)}, {(6,4),(6,5),(6,6),(5,5)}. These pieces do not overlap, so 8 can be achieved. Therefore the maximum value is 8.

raw_record.question_text: What is the maximum number of T-shaped polyominos (shown below) that we can put into a 6 x 6 grid without any overlaps? The blocks can be rotated.

method.method_draft: First describe the pictured block as a T-tetromino: it consists of 4 unit squares, three in a row with a fourth attached to the middle square on one side. From the text, the board is a 6 by 6 square grid and rotations of this T are allowed. Use area to get the preliminary upper bound floor(36/4)=9. Then rule out 9 by a checkerboard coloring of the 6 by 6 grid: the board has 18 black and 18 white squares, while every T-tetromino, in any rotation, covers either 3 black and 1 white or 3 white and 1 black, giving color imbalance ±2. With 9 pieces, the sum of nine ±2 imbalances cannot be 0, so 9 pieces cannot fill the whole board. Finally show 8 is achievable by giving an explicit packing. For example, with rows and columns numbered 1 to 6, place T's on cells: {(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2)}, {(2,1),(3,1),(4,1),(3,2)}, {(4,2),(4,3),(4,4),(3,3)}, {(1,4),(2,4),(3,4),(2,3)}, {(1,5),(2,5),(3,5),(2,6)}, {(3,6),(4,6),(5,6),(4,5)}, {(6,1),(6,2),(6,3),(5,2)}, and {(6,4),(6,5),(6,6),(5,5)}. These are eight nonoverlapping rotated T's, leaving four cells unused, so the maximum is 8.
method.CoT_raw: 图像里给出的拼块是一个 T 形四格骨牌：由 4 个单位正方形组成，3 个连成一排，另 1 个接在中间方块的一侧；题目要求把它放进 6×6 方格中，且允许旋转。先看面积上界：6×6 一共 36 个格子，每个 T 占 4 格，所以最多不超过 floor(36/4)=9 个。再用黑白棋盘染色：6×6 棋盘黑白各 18 格。任一 T 四格无论如何旋转，都会覆盖 3 个同色格和 1 个异色格，因此每个 T 对黑白差值贡献 ±2。若放 9 个并且完全铺满 36 格，总黑白差值必须为 0，但 9 个 ±2 的和除以 2 后是 9 个 ±1 的和，奇数个 ±1 不可能和为 0，所以 9 个不可能。于是上界降到 8。最后给出一个 8 个的具体摆放：按行列 1 到 6 编号，可放在 {(1,1),(1,2),(1,3),(2,2)}，{(2,1),(3,1),(4,1),(3,2)}，{(4,2),(4,3),(4,4),(3,3)}，{(1,4),(2,4),(3,4),(2,3)}，{(1,5),(2,5),(3,5),(2,6)}，{(3,6),(4,6),(5,6),(4,5)}，{(6,1),(6,2),(6,3),(5,2)}，{(6,4),(6,5),(6,6),(5,5)}。这些块互不重叠，因此 8 个可实现。故最大值为 8。
